claudeCodeClients.name: CloudCLI / Claude Code UI

claudeCodeClients.layout: session drawer/sidebar + transcript + tool, git, file and terminal views

claudeCodeClients.name: Happy

claudeCodeClients.layout: workspace and agent sidebar + tabbed chat/editor + file, diff and terminal panes

claudeCodeClients.name: Opcode

claudeCodeClients.name: CodePilot
claudeCodeClients.relationship: Multi-provider desktop agent with Claude Code import and integration
claudeCodeClients.layout: sidebar + chat workspace + split sessions + provider, MCP, skills and media modules
claudeCodeClients.visual: warm monochrome OKLCH default, 16px base radius, diffuse shadows, 12 theme families

claudeCodeClients.name: cdesktop
claudeCodeClients.relationship: Local web UI for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Hermes

claudeCodeClients.name: TOKENICODE
